audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer chart read Akali/Akali/Skill/Skill/Akali/Skill/Skill while content win[0..6] and packet.levelChart both read Diana/Diana/Diana/Diana/Skill/Diana/Diana. Every row disagreed with the row rendered beside it.
audit.why: Diana's Q is 900 range against a 550-range Five Point Strike and Akali has no Shroud until level 2 and no ultimate until 6; at 54.2% over 3,063 games the packet chart is the credible one. Level 6 is the genuine coinflip because Perfect Execution (120s at rank 1) and Moonfall (100s) arrive together.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].side = Diana, phases[4].side = Skill, phases[5..6].side = Diana, with phases[0..4].why rewritten to match each new verdict.

audit.why: Level 2 Shroud, level 3 Lunar Rush, the shared level 6, first item, then Diana's scaling. spikes[] already tracks it. breakdown.carry and breakdown.late were generic Diana boilerplate; carry was grounded onto Shroud's 20s downtime.
audit.corrected: breakdown.carry rewritten around the 20-second Twilight Shroud window.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single decisive interaction was never stated: inside Twilight Shroud Akali is 'unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks', so Lunar Rush — a targeted dash — has no target and cannot follow her in, and the Moonlight mark is worthless while she is inside. Nothing on the page said this.
audit.why: Riot's W text is explicit about untargetability, and Riot's E text says Lunar Rush 'dash[es] to an enemy', i.e. it requires a target. This is what makes the matchup a 7/10 rather than a free lane.
audit.corrected: Stated in winCon, enemyWin, loading, breakdown.cooldowns and dontsFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: The ownerKit revealsStealth flag on Diana's Q contradicts Riot's own description of the ability.
audit.why: Riot's Q text reads that it reveals enemies struck 'if they are not stealthed' — so Q does NOT pull Akali out of Twilight Shroud. Diana's R text does say she 'reveals and draws in all nearby enemies'. Per the brief's rule, the description beats the derived flag.
audit.corrected: No page text was written claiming Q reveals a shrouded Akali. I also declined to claim Moonfall pulls her out of Shroud, because untargetability versus the R pull is not decidable from the kit text.

audit.why: It is the field that carries real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Shroud 20s->16s, Shuriken Flip 16s, Pale Cascade 15s, Moonfall 100s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Assassin's Mark was absent from the whole page — the auto-reset burst tell flagged in missingInteractions.
audit.why: Her combo opens with the empowered auto she gets by leaving the ring her spell damage created, so the ring exit is the cue to step back, not the ability cast.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.mid, replacing a fully templated sentence.

CHART: all seven full-layer sides disagreed with the content-layer win[] rows and with packet.levelChart. I moved the sides onto the existing win[] values, so no paired win[N] edit was possible (before would equal after and be refused). This closes seven cross-layer disagreements rather than creating any. phases[0..4].why were rewritten in the same proposal so every moved row's sentence matches its new verdict; phases[5..6].why already described Diana winning. Ratings left alone — nothing in the kit grounds a change.
phases[2].why on disk was garbled ('E pull joins... no —'), a template leak from a different champion. Replaced.
REPORT CAP: only report[3].t and report[8].t rewritten, per the two-entry limit. report[4].t and report[11].t are still misgendered ('his') and report[1].t still carries the templated shorthand — flagged for a later pass, not touched.
DERIVED FLAG CONFLICT: ownerKit marks Diana's Q revealsStealth, but Riot's text says it reveals 'if they are not stealthed'. Q does not answer Twilight Shroud.
